    Orchestra.Fleet.Node
    |> Ash.Changeset.for_create(:register, Map.merge(%{name: name, region: region, slots_total: slots_total}, opts))

  end

  end

  def list_approvals, do: Ash.read!(Orchestra.Fleet.Approval)
  def list_leases, do: Ash.read!(Orchestra.Fleet.Lease)

  def plan_rollout(targets) do
    # Validation
    if targets == [] do
      {:error, %Ash.Error.Invalid{errors: [%Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument{field: :targets}]}}
    else
      # Check for duplicates and non-positive slots
      node_names = Enum.map(targets, & &1[:node_name])
      if length(Enum.uniq(node_names)) != length(node_names) or Enum.any?(targets, & &1[:slots] <= 0) do
        {:error, %Ash.Error.Invalid{errors: [%Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument{field: :targets}]}}
      else
        total_slots = Enum.reduce(targets, 0, & &1[:slots] + &2)
        {:ok, %{total_slots: total_slots, node_names: Enum.sort(node_names), target_count: length(targets)}}
      end
    end
  end
end

defmodule Orchestra.Fleet do
  use Ash.Domain
  require Ash.Query

  resources do
    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Node
    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Rollout
    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Placement
    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Approval
    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Lease
  end

  # Code Interface
  def register_node(name, region, slots_total, opts \\ %{}) do
    Orchestra.Fleet.Node
    |> Ash.Changeset.for_create(:register, Map.merge(%{name: name, region: region, slots_total: slots_total}, opts))
    |> Ash.create!()
  end

  def get_node(name) do
    Orchestra.Fleet.Node
    |> Ash.Query.filter(name: name)
    |> Ash.read_one!()
  end

  def list_nodes, do: Ash.read!(Orchestra.Fleet.Node)
  def list_rollouts, do: Ash.read!(Orchestra.Fleet.Rollout)
  def list_placements, do: Ash.read!(Orchestra.Fleet.Placement)
  def list_approvals, do: Ash.read!(Orchestra.Fleet.Approval)
  def list_leases, do: Ash.read!(Orchestra.Fleet.Lease)

  def plan_rollout(targets) do
    if targets == [] do
      {:error, %Ash.Error.Invalid{errors: [%Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument{field: :targets}]}}
    else
      node_names = Enum.map(targets, & &1[:node_name])
      if length(Enum.uniq(node_names)) != length(node_names) or Enum.any?(targets, & &1[:slots] <= 0) do
        {:error, %Ash.Error.Invalid{errors: [%Ash.Error.Action.InvalidArgument{field: :targets}]}}
      else
        total_slots = Enum.reduce(targets, 0, & &1[:slots] + &2)
        {:ok, %{total_slots: total_slots, node_names: Enum.sort(node_names), target_count: length(targets)}}
      end
    end
  end
end
